{"id":1837357908,"question_id":4136,"lang":"cpp","lang_name":"C++","time":"8 months","timestamp":1763871771,"status":14,"status_display":"Time Limit Exceeded","runtime":"N/A","url":"/submissions/detail/1837357908/","is_pending":"Not Pending","title":"Concatenate Non-Zero Digits and Multiply by Sum II","memory":"N/A","code":"class Solution {\npublic:\n    const int mod = 1e9 + 7;\n    vector<int> sumAndMultiply(string s, vector<vector<int>>& queries) {\n        vector<int> ansvec;\n        for (auto &range : queries) {\n            int start = range[0];\n            int end = range[1];\n            long long sum = 0;\n            long long ans = 0;\n            for (int i = start; i <= end; i++) \n            {\n                if (s[i] != '0') \n                {\n                    int digit = s[i] - '0';\n                    ans = (ans * 10) % mod;\n                    ans += digit;\n\n                    sum += digit;\n                }\n            }\n            long long n_ans = (ans * sum) % mod;\n            ansvec.push_back((int)n_ans);\n        }\n        return ansvec;\n    }\n};","compare_result":"","title_slug":"concatenate-non-zero-digits-and-multiply-by-sum-ii","has_notes":false,"flag_type":1,"frontend_id":1168}
